## `pm:queue` · `priority:p2` · `domain:cli`

**车道**:落点 `packages/qa/vitest-filter-preflight/**` ⇒ `SKILL.md:251` 的表把 **`packages/qa`** 逐字列在 `domain:cli`。
**档位 p2 —— 判据是「它已经红过一次真实 PR 的必过检查」**:`Test Core (1/6)` 在 PR #18971 上变红(具名 job `105540309254`),而**同一个测试在同一次 run 里对别的 subject 分别跑出 2098 ms 与 1442 ms**(限 5000 ms)⇒ 这是**预算不够**而不是被测对象坏了,且它**溢到无关 PR 上**。⛔ 不到 p1:只测到**一次**,且代价是一次重跑而非错误结论。
⭐ **本席⛔ 不因为卡面自称 flake 就降级** —— 本席的口径是「『flake』不是根因」。这张给出了根因:那条 `it()` 问的是一个**真实 vitest 子进程**,墙钟 = 子进程启动 + 一次运行,而 5000 ms 没有为启动留余量。⇒ 它是**可修的测试缺陷**,⛔ 不是运气。
**升级条件(⛔ 只管本卡)**:测到**第二次**同形红(不同 PR 或不同 run)⇒ 升 `p1` —— 那时它是**重复发生**的事故链,而不是单次。⭐ 同时问**来源**:若测到同一电池里还有别的腿也向真实子进程提问却共用这个 5000 ms 预算 ⇒ 交付物应当从「放宽这一条」改成「让这一类腿有自己的预算」。

## ⛔ The obvious fix is the one to refuse

⛔ **Do not just raise the 5000 ms timeout**, and ⛔ **never** skip, `.skip`, quarantine or `retry` this test. Both make the red go away without answering the question, and a control that was quarantined is no longer a control.

## What the card already measured — inherit it, ⛔ do not re-derive

- the same test on other subjects, **in the same run**, passed at **2098 ms** and **1442 ms** against a 5000 ms limit;
- a **re-run of the same commit passed**;
- the `it()` at `:306` asks a **real vitest child process** a question, so its wall time is child startup plus a run.

⇒ a family habitually consuming **30–40% of its own limit** crosses it on a loaded runner with nothing changed in the code. ⭐ That is the finding: the control's pass/fail is a function of **runner load**, not of the property it claims to assert.

## The question to answer

⭐ **Should a CONTROL leg depend on a real child process at all?** The leg asserts *"refuses NOTHING when no override is named"* — a statement about configuration resolution. Ask what the cheapest instrument is that can still **fail for the reason the control exists to catch**, and say plainly whether that instrument exists here.

Three candidate shapes, ⛔ ranked by the seat as a starting point and not a prescription:

1. **the property is answerable without a child** — then move it, and the flake is gone by construction rather than by tolerance;
2. **the child is load-bearing** (only a real vitest run can be wrong in the way this catches) — then the budget must be derived from measured child-startup cost with headroom **stated and justified**, ⛔ never a round number picked to make today's red go away;
3. the leg conflates two properties, one cheap and one needing the child — then split it.

## Deliverable

Whichever shape you land on, the report must answer: **after this change, what makes this leg go red, and can it still go red for the original reason?** ⛔ A fix that cannot fail is the same defect as a flake, one direction over — and this lane has spent this shift on exactly that class (see the impostor-satisfied controls of #18897).

⚠️ If you conclude the honest answer is "raise the budget", that is acceptable **only** with the measured child-startup distribution behind it and the headroom argued. ⛔ Not a guess.

## Fences

⛔ Never edit `content/docs/releases/`. Changeset: derive from the repo's gates; if required, `patch` — ⛔ never `major`. Commit trailers **model-free**: `Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>` plus a `Claude-Session:` line. English. Draft PR, `Fixes #18982`.

⚠️ If any part of this order is imprecise or contradicts what you measure, **say so and stop rather than silently matching it** — three of this seat's orders were wrong this shift and a dev caught every one.

## Landing record — #18982 is on `main`

PR #19382 merged through the queue at 15:55:04Z. Verified by **content**, ⛔ not by the merge event.

| leg | reading |
|---|---|
| squash commit | `c5d3d1d8b69e84497373c5232a654f0bbffe2b76` |
| shape | `git rev-list --parents -n 1` = **2 fields** ⇒ squash |
| committed | `2026-09-20T15:18:32Z` — the **enqueue** timestamp |
| parent | `3ff6ddf1e97f` |
| pre-squash head | `73e9cc8c64` is **NOT** an ancestor of `origin/main` |

### ⭐ A proper two-sided control, because this diff had one to offer

This is the first landing this shift where a **real** negative control was available — the diff is `+153/−11`, so a line the PR genuinely **removed** existed on the parent:

| probe | on `c5d3d1d8b6` | on the parent `3ff6ddf1e9` |
|---|---|---|
| **needle** — `SPAWNED AT MODULE TOP` | **1** | 0 |
| **negative control** — `16 children, ~9s wall`, a removed line | 0 | **1** |
| the new guard — `expectChildRan` | **4** | 0 |

⭐ Both directions flip across the same boundary. ⛔ Earlier landings this shift had to fall back to running the same probe against two refs, because purely additive diffs offer no removed line — and on #19323 a control chosen without that care read 0 on both sides and discriminated nothing.

### What landed, and why it is not "the timeout was raised"

⛔ **No budget was raised, lowered or disabled; nothing was skipped, retried or quarantined.**

The measurement that reframed the card: on a **synchronous** `execFileSync` body, vitest's `testTimeout` **cannot interrupt anything** — probed with a 1200 ms sync spin under an explicit 300 ms budget, which runs to completion, reports `1210 ms`, and is failed **afterwards**.

⇒ ⭐ the 5000 ms budget was never protecting anything. It could only take a run that had **already produced the correct answer** and turn it red. So the clock **left the verdict** instead of growing: both children spawn once at module top, outside every clocked window (`AGENTS.md:122` — *"Clocked windows measure behaviour, never loading"*, verified present). Clocked window **9.77 s → 33 ms** on the same 65 assertions.

⚠️ The liveness bound did not vanish — it moved onto the **child**, `CHILD_LIVENESS_TIMEOUT_MS = 60_000`, enforced by `spawnSync`.

### ⭐ The round anticipated the way its own fix could go wrong

Moving the clock off a verdict creates a new failure: a child that was **killed or never spawned** could read as a successful refusal. `expectChildRan` refuses that — and ablation C measured the hole it closes: `CHILD_LIVENESS_TIMEOUT_MS = 1` fails **16** cases by name, and **under the old code eight of those would have PASSED** on `status !== 0`.

Ablation **B** is the one this lane should keep: drifting the `REFUSAL` constant fails **8** cases on the refusal leg, proving the CONTROL's **negative** `not.toContain(REFUSAL)` ⛔ cannot go vacuous without eight positive assertions going red first. ⭐ A negative assertion passes when the thing it names is simply absent; B is what makes it evidence.

### The flake, quantified

8 subjects × 5 runs: CONTROL **432–704 ms** for seven, **1521–1942 ms** (median 1663) for `packages/cli` — **33%** of the budget. Against the card's CI readings of 2098/1442 ms, a load factor of ≈**3×** lands `packages/cli` on 5 s exactly.

### Card state

`pm:dispatched` stripped and the assignee cleared in one write, read back.
